title: Top k most frequent words
prompt:
Write topFrequent(String[] words, int k) returning a List<String> (not an array,
not a Set) holding the k most frequent words, most frequent first. Words with the
same count are ordered lexicographically ascending, so the answer is always unique.
k never exceeds the number of distinct words, and k == 0 returns an empty list.
Duplicate words in the input just add to their count.

Examples:
  topFrequent(["i", "love", "java", "i", "love", "coding"], 2)
    -> ["i", "love"]            // both appear twice, "i" sorts first
  topFrequent(["b", "a", "c"], 2)
    -> ["a", "b"]               // all tied at 1, so purely lexicographic

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
